Rules:
- Translate the block as a coherent passage, not as isolated source lines.
- Do not manually insert @h or speaker names. The tool will wrap lines and create game windows automatically.
- Preserve character voice, narrative flow, and important pauses.
- ASCII apostrophes and contractions are allowed. Do not use curly quotes, em dashes, en dashes, or ellipsis characters.
- The English may be longer or shorter than the Japanese if that improves quality.

prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

prompt_parts.label: Glossary
Character Card
prompt_parts.content:
Character card:
# Celica

Role: protagonist and first-person narrator.

Voice:
- Dry, clipped, masculine, restrained.
- Uses short acknowledgments; avoid stiff "Indeed" unless the scene demands it.
- Calm under danger and absurdity.
- Concern is usually indirect and understated.
- Narration can be reflective, but should not become flowery or melodramatic.

Translation notes:
- Keep his internal monologue economical.
- Do not make him sound hesitant or weak.
- His corrections should be gentle rather than lecturing.

Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0014",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 4,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03437-03438",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ちょっといいか？",
      "en": "Got a sec?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03440-03441",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "狭い路地で、互いに部下を従えて睨み合う二人に声を掛けると、\n二人の矢のような視線が同時に俺を射抜く。",
      "en": "In a narrow alley, I call out to the two.\nEach with their own men, their glares pierce me."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03447-03448",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "貴様、何故此処に？",
      "en": "What are you doing here?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03454-03455",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kaura",
      "jp": "なんだ、セリカじゃねえか",
      "en": "Well, if it isn't Celica."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03457-03457",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "同時に言って、二人はまた睨み合う。",
      "en": "They both speak at once, then go back to glaring at each other."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03459-03461",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "アリシアという娘が攫われた事で聞きたい\n事があるんだが……",
      "en": "There's something I want to ask about\na girl named Alicia being kidnapped..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03463-03464",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアの後ろに控えて、苦笑いをしているレフィンに\n肩を竦めて見せた俺はどちらともなく聞いてみた。",
      "en": "Behind Levia, Refin wore a wry smile.\nI shrugged at him and then asked them both."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03466-03469",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kaura",
      "jp": "ああ、それだったら捜索隊を派遣したよ、\n本当だったら全員で探しに行きたいんだけどね、\n此奴らが居るんじゃそうもいかなくてさ",
      "en": "Ah, we dispatched a search party.\nI'd really like to take everyone out there,\nbut thanks to these guys, we're stuck."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03475-03476",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "なにを……我々はこの街に侵略しに来たのではない",
      "en": "What... We didn't come to this town to invade."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03482-03484",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kaura",
      "jp": "どうだか、昨日だってあんたん所の部下が\n占領地気取りで店の売りもんを取り上げているのを見たぜ",
      "en": "I wonder. Just yesterday I saw some of your men...\nActing like occupiers, grabbing goods from a shop."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03490-03491",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "何だと……",
      "en": "What...?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03493-03495",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "レヴィア、アリシアという女の子が攫われたんだが、\nレウィニアの軍は動かせるか？",
      "en": "Levia, a girl named Alicia was kidnapped.\nCan the Lewinian army move out?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03497-03500",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "え？……いや……我々はラティナ王女探索の為に\nこの街に来た以上、それ以外の行動は外交上、\n行う事は出来ない……",
      "en": "Huh? ... No ... Since we came to this town to search for Princess Latina, we cannot act otherwise for diplomatic reasons ..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03502-03503",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうか",
      "en": "I see."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03509-03510",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kaura",
      "jp": "冷たいね、大国の騎士様は",
      "en": "Cold, aren't you, knight of a great nation?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03516-03517",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "くっ……",
      "en": "Tch..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03519-03519",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "カウラの言葉にレヴィアが辛そうに歯噛みする｡",
      "en": "Levia grimaces in pain at Kaura's words."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03521-03522",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "カウラ、それで犯人に心当たりは？",
      "en": "Kaura, any idea who did it?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03528-03530",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kaura",
      "jp": "うーん……それがこの街は治安は悪くないんだけど\n何故か人攫いが結構多くてね……",
      "en": "Hmm... Well, the town's pretty safe, but...\nfor some reason, we've had a lot of kidnappings."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03532-03533",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうなのか？",
      "en": "That so?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03535-03536",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kaura",
      "jp": "ああ、何か手掛かりがあればいいんだけど……",
      "en": "Yeah, if only we had a clue..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03538-03540",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "手掛かり……か……\n俺の頭に昨夜の夢に出てきた頭と呼ばれていた\n男の名前が浮かぶ｡",
      "en": "A clue... huh...\nFrom last night's dream, the name of\nthe man called Head comes to mind."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03542-03543",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "マチス、という男は？",
      "en": "A man named Mathis?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03545-03547",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kaura",
      "jp": "ああ、それだったら北の黒虎岩を根城にしている\n黒狐団て言う山賊の頭だよ",
      "en": "Yeah, that guy's the head of the Black Fox bandits.\nThey hole up at Black Tiger Rock, north of here."
    }
  ]
}
